title: Zest enhancements (Alessandro Secco, 2013 GSoC) in the zest add-on history
description: The 2013 Zest enhancements project in the Student Hall of Fame, set beside the 2013 commits and the later history of the zest add-on.

chapters.title: 2013: Zest in zap-extensions before and during the project
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Zest enhancements (Alessandro Secco) as a 2013 Summer GSoC project. Zest commits in zap-extensions predate the summer:"Added zest and mitmConf"is dated 2013-05-03, and"Issue 751: Change Zest add-on to plug into script console"2013-08-02.

chapters.title: August 2013: loops in the UI
chapters.text: "ZestLoopFile UI + SurroundWith + get/add to Fuzzer Files"is dated 2013-08-12, followed by"edited ZestLoop UI"(2013-08-15) and"changed ZestLoopIntegerDialog.validateFields plus other changes cause of new ZestLoopCode"(2013-08-18). The email-style author names on the commits are not repeated here. The student's end-of-project post lists under"Things Made":"Added Loop to Zest as a new Statement;"and"Added UI in ZAP for the changes above;".

chapters.title: Afterwards: beta, help, relocation
chapters.text: "Zest moved to beta"is dated 2013-09-02 and"Added basic Zest help"2013-09-10."zest: relocate to its own project"is dated 2019-04-03. The add-on is still in zap-extensions: the latest commit under addOns/zest is dated 2026-10-23 ("zest: fix GUI hang when running script with params") and the directory has 277 commits.
